notes_for_editor: Build date conflict unresolved: register says 1951 at its current location, while the November 1953 newspaper item (quoted on Forest Lookouts; original not read) describes a new tower under construction for several months, and the December item calls it the newest link in the chain. The register also allows relocation from an older site. The brief's conflict note says NHLR lists lookouts that were standing when registered; the NHLR page read does not say whether this tower stood in 2017, and no removal date was found, so the note is unverified. Two searches returned no removal record. Newspaper spelling varies (Brann in November, Bram in December). Story says the sources disagree rather than choosing a date.
